title: [Core] Learner App Calendar - All tab empty state uses items copy
description: AC-01 / BR-01 / BR-02 / BR-06. A date with no visible Lesson or Event shows the All-tab message in English and Japanese.
preconditions:
- Learner A can sign in to Learner App.
- On 2030-10-14, Learner A has no visible Lesson and no visible Activity Event.
- Learner App supports English and Japanese.
steps_actions:
1. Sign in as Learner A and set application language to English.
2. Open Calendar, select 2030-10-14, and select the All tab.
3. Read the empty-state text.
4. Change application language to Japanese without changing the selected date or tab.
5. Read the empty-state text.
steps_result:
1. Learner App opens in English.
2. No Lesson or Event card is displayed for the selected date.
3. Text is exactly There are no items scheduled for this date.
4. Calendar remains on 2030-10-14 and All.
5. Text is exactly この日の予定はありません。
steps_data:
1. learner = A; locale = en
2. date = 2030-10-14; tab = All
3. locale = en
4. locale = ja
5. locale = ja
suite: Learner App Calendar - Empty State Messages

title: [Core] Learner App Calendar - Lesson tab empty state uses lessons copy when Event exists
description: AC-02 / BR-01 / BR-03 / BR-06. The Lesson tab must not use generic or Event copy when only an Event exists on the selected date.
preconditions:
- Learner A can sign in to Learner App.
- Published Activity Event Event Only A is visible to Learner A on 2030-10-15.
- Learner A has no visible Lesson on 2030-10-15.
- Learner App supports English and Japanese.
steps_actions:
1. Sign in as Learner A, set language to English, open Calendar, and select 2030-10-15.
2. Select the All tab.
3. Select the Lesson tab.
4. Read the empty-state text.
5. Change language to Japanese without changing date or tab.
6. Read the empty-state text.
steps_result:
1. Calendar opens for the selected date.
2. Event Only A is displayed, proving the selected date is not globally empty.
3. No Lesson card is displayed.
4. Text is exactly There are no lessons scheduled for this date. It is not the All or Event message.
5. Lesson remains selected and no Lesson card appears.
6. Text is exactly この日の授業はありません。
steps_data:
1. learner = A; locale = en; date = 2030-10-15
2. tab = All; event = Event Only A
3. tab = Lesson
4. locale = en
5. locale = ja
6. locale = ja
suite: Learner App Calendar - Empty State Messages
